cards.example_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。
cards.explain_zh: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

cards.example_en: When does the next bus leave for town?
cards.example_zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？
cards.explain_zh: 表将来的时间从句中，when后通常用一般现在时。

cards.example_en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
cards.example_zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

cards.example_en: Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以让学生用日常材料做简单实验，使科学更容易理解。
cards.explain_zh: 主动式make sb do；被动式be made to do。

cards.example_en: Volunteers can make a contribution to the protection of local wildlife.
cards.example_zh: 志愿者可以为保护当地野生生物作出贡献。

cards.example_en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前我们还有时间散步。
cards.explain_zh: 时间通常不可数；表示次数时可数，如three times。

cards.example_en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
cards.example_zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

cards.example_en: What is your favourite subject?
cards.example_zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

cards.example_en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
cards.example_zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。
cards.explain_zh: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。

cards.example_en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
cards.example_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
cards.example_zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。
cards.explain_zh: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

cards.example_en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
cards.example_zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？
cards.explain_zh: other后接名词；others独立使用；两者中另一个用the other。

cards.example_en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。
cards.explain_zh: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

cards.example_en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
cards.example_zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。
cards.explain_zh: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

cards.example_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
cards.explain_zh: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

cards.example_en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
cards.example_zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
cards.explain_zh: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

cards.example_en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
cards.example_zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

cards.example_en: Companies should take responsibility for the waste they produce.
cards.example_zh: 企业应对其产生的废物负责。

cards.example_en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

cards.example_en: She sings very well.
cards.example_zh: 她唱得很好。

cards.example_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
cards.example_zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。
cards.explain_zh: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
cards.example_zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。
cards.explain_zh: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

cards.example_en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
cards.example_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
cards.example_zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。
cards.explain_zh: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。

cards.example_en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
cards.example_zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
cards.example_zh: 进来在火边暖暖手吧。
cards.explain_zh: 不规则变化：come–came–come；come from表示来自。

cards.example_en: Could you open the window, please?
cards.example_zh: 你能打开窗户吗？

cards.example_en: My aunt will work at the hospital on night shifts.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨将在医院上夜班。

cards.example_en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
cards.example_zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？
cards.explain_zh: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

cards.example_en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
cards.example_zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
cards.example_zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。
cards.explain_zh: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

cards.example_en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
cards.example_zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。
cards.explain_zh: now that引导原因从句，强调情况已发生变化。

cards.example_en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
cards.example_zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: First wash your hands, then eat.
cards.example_zh: 先洗手，然后再吃。

cards.example_en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。
cards.explain_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

cards.example_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
cards.example_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。
cards.explain_zh: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。

cards.example_en: She is the only child in her family.
cards.example_zh: 她是家里唯一的孩子。

cards.example_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
cards.example_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。
cards.explain_zh: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

cards.example_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
cards.example_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
cards.example_zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
cards.explain_zh: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

cards.example_en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
cards.example_zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。
cards.explain_zh: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

cards.example_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
cards.example_zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。
cards.explain_zh: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

cards.example_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
cards.example_zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。
cards.explain_zh: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

cards.example_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
cards.example_zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。
cards.explain_zh: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

cards.example_en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
cards.example_zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

cards.example_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
cards.example_zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。
cards.explain_zh: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

cards.example_en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
cards.example_zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
cards.example_zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。
cards.explain_zh: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

word.example_en: Local authorities should take measures to protect historic buildings.
word.example_zh: 地方当局应采取措施保护历史建筑。
